evidence_chain: Claim type: fact. Cached Layer 2 evidence states that Constellation announced a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft to support the launch of the Crane Clean Energy Center and restart of Three Mile Island Unit 1. Source URL: https://www.constellationenergy.com/news/2024/Constellation-to-Launch-Crane-Clean-Energy-Center-Restoring-Jobs-and-Carbon-Free-Power-to-The-Grid.html

Claim type: inference. The Microsoft PPA provides stronger company-specific evidence than broad power-demand narratives because it directly links hyperscaler data-center demand to a named nuclear asset and a long-duration contract.

Claim type: hypothesis. If additional hyperscalers sign similar long-duration nuclear PPAs, existing nuclear fleets may be valued more as scarce strategic infrastructure than as commodity generation assets.
Claim type: fact from cached evidence. Layer 4 identified restart execution, regulatory milestones, capital cost disclosures, and new hyperscaler contracts as the key verification items.
falsification_plan: Downgrade if the Three Mile Island Unit 1 / Crane Clean Energy Center restart is materially delayed, cancelled, or requires materially higher capital spending than disclosed.
Downgrade if regulators impose terms that materially reduce the economics of the Microsoft arrangement or future nuclear PPAs.
Downgrade if Constellation fails to sign additional high-quality long-duration clean-power contracts with hyperscalers or other large loads.
Downgrade if nuclear fleet availability, outage performance, or operating costs deteriorate enough to weaken free cash flow conversion.
Downgrade if evidence emerges that hyperscaler willingness to pay for 24/7 firm nuclear power is falling.
next_research_tasks: Pull latest CEG 10-K, 10-Q, investor presentation, and earnings-call transcript to verify restart timeline, capital expenditure guidance, regulatory milestones, and management commentary on hyperscaler demand.
Track NRC filings and public regulatory updates related to the Crane Clean Energy Center / Three Mile Island Unit 1 restart.
Compare the Microsoft PPA structure with other clean-power procurement deals to estimate whether it is repeatable or one-off.
Build a sensitivity table for nuclear fleet availability, restart capex, PPA pricing assumptions, and free cash flow conversion.
Monitor whether competitors or utilities announce similar nuclear/data-center PPAs, which could either validate the market or reduce CEG-specific scarcity.
risks: Restart risk: Three Mile Island Unit 1 / Crane Clean Energy Center could face delays, technical issues, cost overruns, or cancellation.
Regulatory risk: NRC, state-level, or market-rule developments could impose conditions that reduce project economics.
Execution risk: nuclear operating performance, outage rates, staffing, safety, and maintenance costs could weaken the thesis.
Commercial risk: the Microsoft PPA may prove unique rather than repeatable across other hyperscalers.
Substitution risk: hyperscalers may choose cheaper renewable-plus-storage portfolios, gas-backed power, demand response, or geographically flexible data-center siting instead of premium nuclear PPAs.
Market-pricing risk: the stock may already reflect much of the firm-clean-power scarcity narrative, requiring careful valuation and expectations analysis.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: Demand driver: AI/cloud data centers requiring reliable 24/7 power. System layer: hyperscaler electricity procurement. Chokepoint node: existing nuclear generation and restartable firm carbon-free assets. Public-market mapping: owner/operator of large nuclear fleet with direct hyperscaler PPA evidence. Scarcity mechanism: hard-to-replicate nuclear assets, long licensing and restart timelines, high operational requirements, limited replacement supply.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: Constellation 是能源主题中最接近“稳定、可审计、低碳电力稀缺”卡点的深研目标。AI 数据中心需要长期、稳定、可审计的电力，尤其是 hyperscaler 对 24/7 clean power 的需求正在把核电从普通发电资产重新定价为稀缺基础设施。核电资产许可周期长、重启和运营复杂、资本强度高、替代难度大，因此存量核电组合具备较强瓶颈属性。核心事实证据是公司宣布与 Microsoft 签署 20 年购电协议，用于支持 Crane Clean Energy Center，并重启 Three Mile Island Unit 1。该公司适合作为“AI 数据中心长期电力需求是否愿意为 firm clean power 支付溢价”的核心验证样本。
deep_reports.thesis_en: Constellation is one of the cleanest deep-research targets for the scarce firm carbon-free power chokepoint. AI data centers require reliable, long-duration, auditable electricity, and hyperscaler demand for 24/7 clean power may reprice existing nuclear assets as scarce infrastructure rather than generic generation. Nuclear assets are difficult to replicate because of permitting timelines, operating complexity, capital intensity, and regulatory constraints. The key factual evidence is Constellation's announced 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft to support the Crane Clean Energy Center and restart Three Mile Island Unit 1. CEG is therefore a core test case for whether AI data-center demand is willing to pay a premium for firm clean power.
deep_reports.title_cn: Constellation Energy：稀缺稳定低碳电力的最高纯度样本
deep_reports.title_en: Constellation Energy: high-purity exposure to scarce firm carbon-free power

evidence_chain: Claim type: fact from cached evidence. GE Vernova's Q1 2026 materials reported gas-power equipment backlog and slot-reservation agreements growing from 83 GW to 100 GW. Source URL: https://fortune.com/company-assets/15211/quartr/earnings-release-8-k-ebc20-2026-04-22-10-07-23.pdf

Claim type: fact from cached evidence. GE Vernova reported $2.4 billion of Electrification equipment orders to support data centers. Source URL: https://fortune.com/company-assets/15211/quartr/earnings-release-8-k-ebc20-2026-04-22-10-07-23.pdf
Claim type: inference. Slot-reservation growth is stronger evidence than generic management optimism because customers appear to be reserving scarce future production capacity.

Claim type: hypothesis. If turbine and electrification lead times remain extended, GEV may have improved pricing power and backlog quality, but this must be verified through margins, cancellation rates, and cash conversion.
falsification_plan: Downgrade if gas-power backlog, slot-reservation agreements, or electrification orders flatten, decline, or show rising cancellations.
Downgrade if management commentary indicates data-center orders are small, non-recurring, or less profitable than broader backlog.
Downgrade if segment margins fail to improve despite backlog growth.
Downgrade if warranty, quality, or execution costs rise materially.
Downgrade if turbine and grid-equipment lead times normalize faster than expected, reducing scarcity value.
next_research_tasks: Pull latest GEV 10-Q, earnings deck, and transcript to verify current Gas Power backlog, slot-reservation terms, Electrification orders, lead times, and cancellation rates.
Separate AI/data-center demand from utility replacement demand, power-cycle recovery, and non-AI electrification orders.
Track segment-level margin conversion, free cash flow conversion, working capital, and warranty expense.
Compare GEV turbine lead-time commentary with Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power, and utility procurement disclosures.
Build an order-to-revenue bridge by segment to test whether backlog growth can convert into earnings rather than remaining a narrative.
risks: Backlog-quality risk: orders and slot reservations may not convert into profitable revenue at expected timing or margins.
Cycle risk: demand may reflect a broad power-cycle recovery rather than durable AI/data-center incremental demand.
Execution risk: manufacturing delays, supply-chain shortages, labor constraints, and project complexity could limit revenue conversion.
Margin risk: input costs, warranty expenses, contract terms, or quality issues could consume expected operating leverage.
Normalization risk: if turbine, transformer, or electrification lead times normalize quickly, the chokepoint premium could fade.
Market-pricing risk: investor expectations may already assume strong order conversion and margin expansion.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: Demand driver: AI data centers and broader electrification increasing power-capacity needs. System layer: new generation, grid expansion, and substation/electrification buildout. Chokepoint node: gas turbine production slots, electrification equipment, grid hardware, and delivery capability. Public-market mapping: OEM and systems supplier with gas-power and electrification backlog exposure. Scarcity mechanism: long equipment lead times, limited global turbine manufacturing capacity, transformer/grid-equipment constraints, and high execution complexity.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: GE Vernova 是能源主题中“新增可调度电源与电气化设备供给受限”的关键深研目标。AI 数据中心负荷增长不只需要电力需求，还需要燃机、变压器、电网设备、电气化系统和工程交付能力，把新增容量从规划转化为可用电力。缓存证据显示，公司 Q1 2026 材料披露燃气电力设备 backlog 和 slot-reservation agreements 从 83GW 增至 100GW，并披露 Electrification 设备订单中有 24 亿美元支持数据中心。这说明能源主题已经从抽象负荷增长进入设备订单、排产名额和交付能力层面。GEV 的研究价值在于它可以验证 AI 电力瓶颈是否正在转化为设备供应链定价权。
deep_reports.thesis_en: GE Vernova is a key deep-research target for the constrained supply of new dispatchable generation and electrification equipment. AI data-center load growth does not only require electricity demand; it requires turbines, transformers, grid equipment, electrification systems, and delivery capacity to convert planned capacity into usable power. Cached evidence from Q1 2026 materials showed gas-power equipment backlog and slot-reservation agreements increasing from 83 GW to 100 GW, plus $2.4 billion of Electrification equipment orders to support data centers. This suggests the theme is moving from abstract load growth into equipment orders, production slots, and execution capacity. GEV is a strong research target for testing whether AI power scarcity is translating into equipment-supply pricing power.
deep_reports.title_cn: GE Vernova：燃机交付名额与电气化设备的供给卡点
deep_reports.title_en: GE Vernova: gas turbine slots and electrification equipment as supply bottlenecks

Claim type: fact from cached evidence. Quanta Services reported Q1 2026 revenues of $7.87 billion, remaining performance obligations of $26.2 billion, total backlog of $48.5 billion, and increased substantially all 2026 financial expectations. Source URL: https://investors.quantaservices.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/396/quanta-services-reports-first-quarter-2026-results
Claim type: inference. Large interconnection queues and Quanta's backlog together suggest that grid execution is a real bottleneck rather than merely a financing or generation problem.

Claim type: hypothesis. If AI data-center load growth continues to require substation, transmission, and distribution upgrades, Quanta may benefit from multi-year utility and customer-funded infrastructure spending.
falsification_plan: Downgrade if electric-power segment growth slows while backlog quality deteriorates.
Downgrade if backlog conversion weakens, project margins compress, or labor constraints prevent execution.
Downgrade if utility customers defer or reduce grid capex plans.
Downgrade if regulators prevent recovery of data-center-driven infrastructure costs or force structures that reduce Quanta's addressable work.
Downgrade if data-center-related project awards fail to appear in backlog, RPO, or management commentary.
next_research_tasks: Pull latest PWR 10-Q, earnings release, investor presentation, and transcript to break down backlog by electric power, renewable, underground utility, and data-center-adjacent work.
Track electric-power segment margins, labor availability, wage pressure, and backlog conversion rates.
Compare Quanta commentary with utility capex plans from AEP, Dominion, Duke, NextEra, and other large-load regions.
Monitor interconnection, substation, and transmission awards tied to data-center corridors.
Build a regional exposure map linking Quanta projects to PJM, ERCOT, MISO, SPP, and high-data-center-load geographies.
risks: Labor risk: skilled electrical labor availability and wage pressure could limit growth or compress margins.
Backlog-mix risk: total backlog may include work less directly tied to AI/data-center and grid-chokepoint demand.
Project-margin risk: fixed-price work, weather, execution delays, or supply-chain issues could hurt profitability.
Utility capex risk: customers may defer capital spending if rates, financing costs, or regulatory approvals become less favorable.
Regulatory risk: regulators may disallow cost recovery for infrastructure tied to large-load customers or require more customer-funded structures.
Demand-timing risk: data-center projects may be delayed, relocated, or redesigned around self-generation and behind-the-meter solutions.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: Demand driver: AI/data-center load growth, utility grid hardening, renewable interconnection, and electrification. System layer: transmission, substations, distribution, interconnection, and field execution. Chokepoint node: skilled labor, grid construction capacity, permitting execution, utility project delivery, and large-scale electrical infrastructure services. Public-market mapping: engineering and construction services provider with large backlog and electric-power exposure. Scarcity mechanism: limited skilled labor, long permitting and interconnection queues, complex utility coordination, and constrained field-execution capacity.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: Quanta Services 是能源主题中最适合验证“电力不只是发出来，还要送得到”的深研目标。AI 数据中心即使拿到电源，也需要输电、变电、配电、现场施工、互联和公用事业资本开支，把电送到可用位置。缓存证据显示，Berkeley Lab 报告美国互联队列规模巨大，约 10,300 个活跃项目、约 1,400GW 发电和 890GW 储能，说明并网和电网拥堵是实质瓶颈。Quanta Q1 2026 披露收入 78.7 亿美元、剩余履约义务 262 亿美元、总 backlog 485 亿美元，并上调 2026 年大部分财务预期。PWR 的研究价值在于它横跨数据中心、电网升级、公用事业投资、可再生能源接入和电力可靠性多个需求源，是“能源主题从需求叙事进入现场施工”的关键样本。
deep_reports.thesis_en: Quanta Services is a strong deep-research target for testing the idea that electricity must not only be generated but physically delivered. Even when AI data centers secure generation, they still need transmission, substations, distribution, utility work, field construction, interconnection, and permitting to make power usable at the site. Cached evidence from Berkeley Lab shows a very large U.S. interconnection queue, with about 10,300 active projects representing roughly 1,400 GW of generation and 890 GW of storage, supporting the view that interconnection and grid congestion are real bottlenecks. Quanta's Q1 2026 evidence showed $7.87 billion of revenue, $26.2 billion of remaining performance obligations, $48.5 billion of total backlog, and increased substantially all 2026 financial expectations. PWR is a key test case for whether energy demand is converting into physical grid work and field execution.

deep_reports.title_en: Quanta Services: grid construction, substations, and interconnection execution as real-world bottlenecks

memory_update.key_decision: Selected CEG, GEV, and PWR as the strongest deep-research targets because they map to distinct and high-quality chokepoints: firm carbon-free generation, power/electrification equipment supply, and grid construction/interconnection execution.
next_layer_focus: Verify latest filings and transcripts for CEG, GEV, and PWR.
Build valuation-neutral operating dashboards rather than price targets.

summary: Layer 5 selects three strongest deep-research targets from the Energy theme funnel based on chokepoint purity, evidence quality, public-market mapping, and falsifiability. The selected targets are Constellation Energy, GE Vernova, and Quanta Services. Together they cover three critical AI-era energy bottlenecks: scarce firm carbon-free generation, constrained gas-power/electrification equipment supply, and physical grid construction/interconnection execution. This is a research-priority output only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
